content:
Apple's fall product lineup this year is quite rich, including the new iPhone, Mac, iPad and more. Below are all the new Apple products rumoured to launch starting September 9.

iPhone: New iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max, plus the iPhone Ultra

Apple's flagship iPhone 18 series will move towards an ultra-premium positioning this fall, with the base iPhone 18 cancelled; the base model is reportedly delayed to early 2027.

  • iPhone 18 Pro: Major camera upgrades, a brand-new unique colour option, a smaller Dynamic Island, and more
  • iPhone 18 Pro Max: The largest battery capacity ever, and may exclusively feature specific camera functions
  • iPhone Ultra: The first ever foldable iPhone in Apple's history

Wearables: AirPods 5, Apple Watch Ultra 4, Apple Watch Series 12

Apple is reportedly set to unveil three new wearables at its September event: AirPods 5 and updated versions of two flagship Apple Watch models.

  • AirPods 5: New models with simultaneous updates to both the base version and the active noise cancellation version
  • Apple Watch Ultra 4: New health sensors, refreshed exterior design, and more
  • Apple Watch Series 12: Upgraded S-series chip, new health features

Mac: MacBook Ultra, new M6 MacBook Pro, and more

Apple has already launched several new Macs this year, but three more models are reportedly on the way, expected to debut in October.

  • MacBook Ultra: A brand-new high-end model featuring an OLED display, touch support, and more
  • M6 MacBook Pro: An update to the entry-level MacBook Pro with the M6 chip
  • M6 iMac: Fresh new colour options

iPad: OLED iPad mini, and possibly a base-model iPad

The new iPad Air launched earlier this year, but two more iPads may appear before the end of 2026: an iPad mini with an OLED display, and an all-new base-model iPad.

  • New iPad mini: OLED display and upgraded chip
  • Base iPad: A18 chip to support Apple Intelligence

Apple Home products: Apple TV 4K, HomePad, and more

Apple plans to significantly expand its Home product line, but has reportedly been waiting for Siri AI features to arrive. Here's the upcoming product lineup.

  • New Apple TV 4K: Upgraded A-series chip, Apple Intelligence, all-new Siri Remote
  • HomePad / HomePod Touch: A new home hub featuring a 7-inch touch screen and magnetic base
  • HomePod 3: An upgraded full-size HomePod with a new chip to support Apple Intelligence
  • HomePod mini 2: New chip, improved sound, and more
  • Apple security camera: The first first-party smart home accessory to support HomeKit Secure Video

Apple has also reportedly been developing a video doorbell product with Face ID, but there have been no updates on this for quite some time.

Which of the new Apple products coming this fall are you planning to buy? Let us know in the comments section.
